title.zh: 发布首日真实学习验收证据

purpose.en: Publish the August 21 production QA evidence and its microphone and administrator-ledger blockers without claiming a full pass.
purpose.zh: 发布 8 月 21 日正式站验收证据及麦克风与管理员账本复核受阻项，不声称全量通过。

en: Add a bilingual administrator Project report for day one of the 21-day real-learning campaign.
Record per-language planned and measured minutes, deep-focus skill, Course, SmartCard, Everyday Speaking, quiz, and learning-log evidence.
Label unavailable microphone scoring and administrator-level ledger verification as blocked.
zh: 在管理员 Project 中加入 21 天真实学习计划首日双语报告。
逐语记录计划与实测分钟、深度技能、课程、SmartCard、生活口语、测验与学习日志证据。
将不可用的麦克风评分与管理员级账本复核明确标记为受阻。
8 月 21 日正式站验收证据

en: Append a dated report to the versioned Project fallback so the runtime document reconciler exposes it without overwriting historical reports.
Use only the anonymized learner key and non-secret production evidence.
Keep the report explicitly blocked where real speech input or administrator-only read access was unavailable.
zh: 向版本化 Project 回退文档追加当日报告，由运行时文档对账器合并展示且不覆盖历史报告。
只使用匿名学习者键与非敏感正式站证据。
真实语音输入或管理员只读权限不可用时，报告明确保持受阻。

en: Sentence and QA contracts pass for 36 course banks, 120 sentences per bank, and ten unique daily Listening and Writing items.
The August 21 route preflight passed all 16 anonymous production route checks.
Real signed-in Chrome evidence covers four target languages, five Course skills, SmartCard, Everyday Speaking navigation, server quiz scores, persisted learning logs, and a clean console.
zh: 句子与测试合同通过：36 个课程题库、每库 120 句，Listening 与 Writing 每日各 10 道唯一题。
8 月 21 日匿名正式站 route preflight 的 16 项检查全部通过。
真实登录 Chrome 证据覆盖四种目标语言、课程五技能、SmartCard、生活口语导航、服务器测验分数、持久化学习日志及无错误控制台。

en: Real microphone scoring and administrator-only ledger verification remain blocked and require a later authorized retry.
zh: 真实麦克风评分与管理员专属账本复核仍受阻，需要后续授权重试。

en: This release publishes SmartLingo-specific QA evidence only and changes no learner data, scoring logic, course content, identity, commerce, or classroom boundary.
zh: 本次只发布 SmartLingo 专属验收证据，不改变学习数据、评分逻辑、课程内容、身份、商业或课程教室边界。
